profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California. As of January 25, 2026, the company reported revenue of $215,938,000,000. NVIDIA describes itself as building agentic AI with multimodal foundation models and positions the Nemotron family as highly efficient, multimodal, open AI models designed for long-running, self-evolving agents that deliver reasoning and accuracy for complex agent workflows.

The Nemotron product family includes multiple specialized models available through NVIDIA NIM microservices for enterprise deployment. According to the company's site, Nemotron models excel in agentic AI tasks including reasoning, multimodal vision, retrieval-augmented generation, speech, and safety. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning helps agents complete specialized tasks, while Nemotron Speech models provide high-throughput automatic speech recognition, text-to-speech, and neural machine translation for agentic applications. Nemotron Retriever models deliver document understanding and structured information extraction. NVIDIA publishes training datasets, techniques, and model weights under the NVIDIA Open Model License, which permits commercial deployment without crediting NVIDIA. The company offers deployment options including NVIDIA RTX PRO and NVIDIA DGX Spark, along with tools such as NVIDIA Dynamo and TensorRT-LLM for production scaling.

NVIDIA operates as a public company regulated in California, with 220 cases tracked in the state jurisdiction.
